workflow_permission.condition: Before publishing workflow changes, verify active publication authorization and credential workflow scope. The prior scope refusal is historical; do not assume it persists or switch identities to bypass a new refusal.
workflow_permission.blocks: Publish changes to GitHub workflow files.

privileged_linux.condition: Provide an explicitly authorized disposable Linux environment with the required kernel features, resource limits, and at least 50 GiB free. Mocked calls do not satisfy this gate.
privileged_linux.blocks: Run the privileged Linux bootstrap experiment.

repository_policy_approval.condition: James approves the concrete protection changes from GL-023 before an executor applies them. A task card alone does not authorize remote settings changes.

release_signing_setup.condition: The repository owner enables the selected release identity and required permissions. Do not export private keys or improvise signing identities.

consenting_trial_maintainer.condition: A real runner maintainer agrees to the named trial and its observations. Do not send recruitment messages without authorization.

elapsed_trial_observations.condition: This is a completion gate, not a gate on trial setup. The agreed repeated workday observations must exist. Simulated runs cannot satisfy elapsed real use.

release_publication_approval.condition: James approves the exact version, verified artifacts, and public release after reviewing the completion matrix.
release_publication_approval.blocks: Record final release approval or publish the release.

native_probe_approval.condition: James authorizes the specific bounded native terminal probe. The standing installation check exception does not authorize an arbitrary host campaign.
native_probe_approval.blocks: Run the bounded native terminal probe.

installed_cutover_approval.condition: Apply an installed default-CLI change only within active deployment authorization for the concrete reviewed candidate. Prior authorization persists; the task does not authorize installation by itself.
installed_cutover_approval.blocks: Replace the workstation installed default CLI.

fencing_target.condition: Identify and agree on one real enforceable resource domain, access boundary, permitted mutations, and bounded target environment. No target is selected by the generic proposal.
fencing_target.blocks: Run mutation-boundary experiments against the selected resource.

scope: Current published plan plus the staged Rust direction and bounded prototype/native audit. The roadmap is the sole active task set; historical cards survive in Git and Reader, not duplicate active files.
